purpose: Test whether the previous WebAI Bridge campaign underperformed because X optimized for link clicks without a verified website signal.

new_baseline.landing_page: Keep current WebAI Bridge LP content unchanged; X Pixel base code is now installed

preflight_gate: Do not launch while the Landing Page View event is UNVERIFIED / has no observed activity.
Open the deployed landing page in a real browser and confirm the X Pixel fires, preferably with X Pixel Helper or Events Manager.
Pause the old WAB_LP_TEST_B2 line item before launching the new baseline so campaigns do not compete or continue spending in parallel.
changed_variable: Optimization/measurement signal: LINK_CLICKS with no primary event -> verified Landing Page View website signal

checkpoint.note: 20 LPVs is a directional checkpoint, not a statistical-significance claim. Stop at the spend cap if not reached.

phase_2_only_after_phase_1: If LPV tracking works, test targeting separately. Do not change targeting during this baseline because the old 20 BROAD_KEYWORD criteria are OR-combined, not a 20-way AND filter.
